name: Web Research Agent
description: Stateless schema-driven web research enricher — takes caller-supplied rows + research prompt + optional sources, uses web_search to enrich each row, captures per-URL reachability checks, and returns enrichedRows + extractionNotes + failures + webChecks. Hard bounds: rows.length in [1, 20], sources.length <= 10.

inputs.title: rows
inputs.description: The rows to enrich. Leave empty and name a source instead.

inputs.title: rowsSource
inputs.description: Where the rows come from: an artifact already in the workspace, or a file.

inputs.title: prompt
inputs.description: What this research should find out about each row.

outputs.title: enrichedRows
outputs.description: One slot per input row at the same index: the caller's own row extended with a researchNotes string array and any fields the caller's outputSchema asks for. The per-row shape is the caller's own, so this list is intentionally free-form and this package declares no members for it.

outputs.title: failures
outputs.description: One entry per row the run could not enrich; the run continues past a failure.

rowIndex.description: The 0-indexed position in rows; -1 when the whole call was refused before any row was read.

error.description: A short snake_case tag: no_data, web_search_failed, schema_violation, input_bounds or missing_prompt; a novel failure mode carries its own snake_case tag and spells it out in detail.

detail.description: One sentence elaborating the failure; empty when there is nothing to add.

outputs.title: webChecks
outputs.description: One entry per URL the run attempted, deduplicated by URL; an unreachable URL is an observation, not a failure.

reachable.description: False for a 404, a timeout, a CAPTCHA wall or a page with no static content.

note.description: One sentence about what was found at the URL; empty when there is nothing to add.

data.system: You are a stateless web-research enricher. Follow the SKILL.md step-by-step. When rows is empty, read the rows from rowsSource first: for type "artifact" call artifact_representation_get with the ref, for type "file" read the file the ref names, and parse its rows before enriching. Use the web_search tool to verify and enrich each row. Return a single JSON object with {enrichedRows, extractionNotes, failures, webChecks} — nothing else.

cinatra.description: Single ApiNode -> /api/llm-bridge. Bridge resolves the agent's DECLARED skill dependency edge (cinatra.dependencies -> @cinatra-ai/web-research-skill, kind:"skill") and mounts that extension's single bundle; the skill is no longer embedded in this repo (cinatra#2090) and injects the web_search tool via metadata.cinatra.toolboxes (declaredToolboxIds=['web_search'] filter). The LLM uses web_search ONLY — no MCP primitives — to verify facts in each caller-supplied row and capture per-URL reachability.
